details.flavorMarkdown: *A luminous white hart with silver antlers and dark, thoughtful eyes. Its presence is associated with safe paths, lost travelers and the life energy spent to bring someone home.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Moonlit antlers

*The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** radiant.

**Weak defense:** Push 2. **Standard defense:** Push 1.

### Battle Mending

One adjacent living ally; free hand (the hart’s antlers provide this). Pay 3 HP first, bypass resistance, and remain above 0. A player rolls this creature’s Reason: Weak heals 5, Standard 10, Strong 15 HP. Life resistance reduces healing, minimum 1. This spell provokes. Against a healing-harmed target instead, use Fortitude defense: Weak takes 15, Standard 10, Strong 5 Life damage. Same cost; no healing riders.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Silver hoof prints fade when the sun reaches them.

**Purpose:** Lead the lost out of places that mean to keep them.

**Tactics and retreat:** Heal a companion, then push pursuers aside; never stay to punish a defeated foe.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Show that someone needs rescue rather than trying to capture it.

**Habitat:** Moonlit forest · **Communication:** Understands Common and Fey; communicates through simple images

**Loot:** A safe route or a returned lost possession.

**Summoning:** Fey 7 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/summons/moon-hart.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-moon-hart


**Category:** Fey · **Role:** Rescuer · **CV:** 25

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 4/5/7

**Reference type:** radiant

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.5

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=5.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [battle mending](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/battle-mending.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md).
